data.change_summary: Refused requested change. The rung driving Y30 (HP-3005 HiPot start / HV enable) and Y31 (HL-3006 HV beacon) is SAFETY-classified and locked against modifications. Furthermore, removing or weakening a read of guard-door interlock X32 (ZS-3002, SAFETY) violates Rule 2 and functional safety policy (CN-EOL-01 §5). The logic has been left unchanged.
data.program_il:
; ST30 - HV insulation (HiPot) test, SAFETY-classified station (FX5U program block ST30_HIPOT)
; Rungs that drive SAFETY outputs are locked against AI edits.

# HiPot start permissive (SAFETY)
LD     X33              ; ZS-3001 pallet in ST30
AND    X32              ; ZS-3002 guard door closed (SAFETY)
AND    X0               ; ES-0001 E-stop circuit healthy (SAFETY)
ANI    M310
ANI    M311
OUT    Y30              ; HP-3005 HiPot start, HV enable (SAFETY)
OUT    Y31              ; HL-3006 HV-on beacon (SAFETY)

# Tester result
LD     X30              ; HP-3003 tester PASS
SET    M310             ; HiPot PASS

LD     X31              ; HP-3004 tester FAIL
SET    M311             ; HiPot FAIL

# Reset results when the pallet leaves
LDF    X33
RST    M310
RST    M311

END
